newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Chilanga Cement leads way.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Chilanga Cement leads way.

text.p: Traded volumes rose on the Lusaka Stock Exchange in the week ended November 29 as international buyers resumed trading after a break during Zambia's election period, exchange officials said.
They said 128,865 shares worth 2,035,638 kwacha exchanged hands, compared to 5,585 shares worth 301,858 kwacha the previous week.

"International demand for shares, which paused during the election period, has rebounded strongly, hampered only by the inadequate supply of shares as major stockholders assess the prospects for capital gains and improved dividends in 1997," an exchange spokesman said.
Chilanga Cement remained steady at 52 kwacha in a traded volume of 11,308 shares valued at 585,513 kwacha.
Rothmans, steady at 33 kwacha, saw 12,400 shares worth 409,200 kwacha exchange hands.
Zambia Sugar remained steady at 11 kwacha in a traded volume of 43,289 shares valued at 476,179 kwacha.
Farmers House and Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) saw no trades during the week.
